topic: Picking a Gift for a Friend

script.title: THE GIFT SHOP
script.scene_zh: 禮品店 · 挑生日禮物
script.story_hook: One friend's big birthday, one helpful gift-shop clerk.
script.intro_zh: 好友的大生日，遇上一位熱心的禮品店店員。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a cozy gift shop today. Listen for words about picking presents.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到一間溫馨的禮品店。今天留意挑選禮物的說法。
script.outro: A wrapped gift and a happy shopper. Listen once more and repeat the lines.
script.outro_zh: 禮物包好了，購物的人也開心。再聽一遍，跟著說這些句子。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to say every line with us.
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length auburn hair in a loose braid over one shoulder, a cream knit cardigan, high-waisted jeans, a small heart pendant, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful middle-aged man in his fifties with silver-grey hair combed back, wire-frame glasses, a bushy mustache, a burgundy shop vest over a rolled-sleeve white shirt, dark suspenders, and a stocky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need help picking a birthday gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ˈniːd hɛlp ˈpɪkɪŋ ə ˈbɝθˌdeɪ ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要幫忙挑生日禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help! Who's it for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp huz ɪt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 很樂意幫忙！請問是送給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My best friend Sam, she turns thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɛst frɛnd sæm ʃi tɝnz ˈθɜɾi/
dialogue.zh: 我最好的朋友小珊，她要滿三十歲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big one! Any hobbies we can work with?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡ wʌn ˈɛni ˈhɑˌbiz wi kən wɝk wɪð/
dialogue.zh: 大生日耶！她有什麼愛好可以參考嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, she loves cooking and terrible puns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ʃi lʌvz ˈkʊkɪŋ ænd ˈtɝɪbl pʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，她愛下廚，還愛講超冷的諧音梗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, that's my favorite kind of customer.
dialogue.phonetic: /u ðæts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt kaɪnd əv ˈkʌstəməɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這種客人是我最喜歡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, hope you can talk me into something.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ hoʊp ju kən ˈtɔk mi ˈɪntə ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那就靠你推我一把了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, we have a fancy apron right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wi hæv ə ˈfænsi ˈeɪpɹən ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們這裡剛好有一條很漂亮的圍裙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, but she already owns two aprons.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm bʌt ʃi ɔlˈɛdi ˈoʊnz tu ˈeɪpɹənz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，可是她已經有兩條圍裙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, gifts should beat what people have.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ɡɪfts ʃʊd bit wʌt ˈpipəl hæv/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，禮物要比對方手上已有的更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly! I want her to say wow, you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ wɑnt ʃɚ tə seɪ ˈwaʊ ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是！我想讓她發出「哇」的那種驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about this punny knife set? 'Steak and defend.'
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈpʌni naɪf sɛt steɪk ænd dɪˈfɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 這組諧音刀架怎麼樣？上面寫著「牛排，開戰」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Cute, but knives feel a little risky.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kjuːt bʌt naɪvz fil ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈɹɪski/
dialogue.zh: 哈！很可愛，但送刀總覺得有點冒險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Risky how? They're nice German steel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪski haʊ ðɪrz naɪs dʝɝmən stil/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼冒險？這可是漂亮的德國鋼材耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if she's not into cooking anymore?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ʃi z ɑt ˈɪntə ˈkʊkɪŋ ˈɛnimɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 要是她現在不愛做飯了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, hobbies change. Anything else on her list?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ˈhɑˌbiz tʃeɪndʒ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ɑn hɚ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 也對，興趣會變。她清單上還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She mentioned a nice candle lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈmɛnʃənd ə naɪs ˈkændl ˈleɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 她最近提過想要一個好看的蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've got soy candles, three scents in stock.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːv ɡɑt sɔɪ ˈkændlz θɹi sɛnts ɪn stɑk/
dialogue.zh: 我們有大豆蠟燭，現貨三種香味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one sells best?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn sɛlz bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 哪一款賣最好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee and walnut, weirdly enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔˌfi ænd ˈwɑlnət ˈwɪɹdli ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 是咖啡核桃味，說來好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weirdly perfect for her, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪɹdli ˈpɝfɪkt fɚ hɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 但老實說，對她來說是完美風味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one's twenty-two, the small six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪɡ wʌnz ˈtwɛnti tu ðə smɑl sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 大杯二十二美元，小杯六美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oof, my budget's a little smaller.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊf maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪts ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈsmɑləɹ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我的預算比這個再低一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, what were you hoping to spend?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm wʌt wɪɹ ju ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə spɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，你原本想花多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, around fifteen, maybe twenty at most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm əˈɹaʊnd fɪfˈtin ˈmeɪbi ˈtwɛnti æt moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，十五塊左右，最多二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the small size is your friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə smɑl saɪz ɪz jɔɹ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那小杯就是你的好朋友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one's six dollars, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌnz sɪks ˈdɑləz ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個是六美元對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, six with the pretty tin included.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp sɪks wɪð ðə ˈpɹɪti tɪn ɪnˈkluːdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，六塊錢還附漂亮的鐵罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! Can I get two scents, one each?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld kən aɪ ɡɛt tu sɛnts wʌn itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 買它！可以兩種香味各來一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, mix and match is totally allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɚ mɪks ænd mætʃ ɪz ˈtoʊɾəli əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 當然，自由搭配完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, add the vanilla one too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt æd ðə vəˈnɪlə wʌn tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，再加一個香草味的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice pair. Want a gift receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs pɛɹ wɑnt ə ɡɪft rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 很搭的一對。要不要禮物收據？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh yes, totally needed for surprise stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jɛs ˈtoʊɾəli ˈniːddɪd fɚ sɚˈpɹaɪz sʌf/
dialogue.zh: 哦要啊，玩驚喜一定要有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hides the price and just shows our store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt haɪdz ðə pɹaɪs ænd dʒʌst ʃoʊz ˈaʊɚ stɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 它會遮住價格，只顯示店名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my secret's safe with that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ ˈsikɹɪts seɪf wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這樣我的秘密就守住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, wrapping? Paper's free, boxes are two.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈɹæpɪŋ ˈpeɪpɚz fɹi ˈbɑksəz ɑɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 接著，包裝？包裝紙免費，小盒子兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wrap it right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju ɹæp ɪt ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你們可以在這裡幫我包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, give me one quick minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli ɡɪv mi wʌn kwɪk ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，給我一分鐘就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你真是救星，太感謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, um, we're out of the gold paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ʌm wɪɹ ˈaʊt əv ðə ɡoʊld ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，嗯，金色包裝紙剛好用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, gold was her whole theme.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ɡoʊld wəz hɚ hoʊl θim/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，金色是她整場派對的主題色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we have sparkly silver, birthday-approved.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt wi hæv ˈspɑɹkli ˈsɪlvɚ ˈbɝθˌdeɪ əˈpɹud/
dialogue.zh: 不過我們有閃亮銀色，生日認證等級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, silver works, she's pretty easygoing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ˈsɪlvɚ wɝks ʃiz ˈpɹɪti ˈiziˌɡoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，銀色也行，她個性很隨和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice. Card or cash for these?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tʃɔɪz kɑɹd ɔɹ kæʃ fɚ ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。這單刷卡還是付現？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, and can I split the payment?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ænd kən aɪ splɪt ðə ˈpeɪkmənt/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，還有可以拆成兩筆付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, one payment only per order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi wʌn ˈpeɪkmənt ˈoʊnli pɚ ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，一筆訂單只能一次付清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine, the total's small anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn ðə ˈtoʊɾəlz smɑl ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，反正總額不大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen dollars with the little box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔːˈtin ˈdɑləz wɪð ðə ˈlɪɾəl bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 加小盒子共十四美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, my wallet survived that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪ ˈwɑlət sɚˈvaɪvd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我的錢包平安無事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, but it survived.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɹli bʌt ɪt sɚˈvaɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 勉強算是，但它撐過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I pick the wrapped one up?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn kən aɪ pɪk ðə ɹæpt wʌn ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候能來拿包好的禮物？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can wrap it now, or hold it for pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən ɹæp ɪt naʊ ɔɹ hoʊld ɪt fɚ ˈpɪkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就能包，也可以留給你來取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it please, my party's tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt pliz maɪ ˈpɑɹtiz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請先留著，我派對是今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep it behind the counter till six.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ kip ɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkaʊnɾɚ tɪl sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 我放收銀台後面留到六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is perfect, I'll be back by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ˈpɝfɪkt aɫ bi bæk baɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 六點剛好，派對前我會再過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just show this little slip at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ʃoʊ ðɪs ˈlɪɾəl slɪp æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 屆時把這張小憑條出示給櫃台就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. This was easier than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ðɪs wəz ˈiziɚ ðæn aɪ fɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。挑禮物比我想的簡單多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gift shopping's my day job, after all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪft ˈʃɑˌpɪŋz maɪ deɪ dʒɑb ˈæftɚ ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 畢竟選禮物就是我的本行嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Sam's going to love these.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju sæmz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə lʌv ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你！小珊一定會愛上這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a wonderful party, you two!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈpɑɹti ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 祝你們派對玩得盡興！

script.youtube_title: 【挑禮物超崩潰🎁】「牛排，開戰？」買蠟燭居然這麼有趣🕯️｜預算＋收據＋包裝一次學會🛍️｜60句沉浸英文聽力｜Picking a Gift for a Friend
script.youtube_title_en: "Steak and Defend" — Picking the Perfect Birthday Gift at a Shop
script.youtube_description:
「牛排，開戰？」——在禮品店幫最好的朋友挑三十歲生日禮物，會聽到哪些實用的英文？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在溫暖的小禮品店櫃台。

你會聽到：說明送禮對象與預算的完整句；從圍裙、刀架換到蠟燭的聊天技巧；禮物收據怎麼要、包裝紙賣完怎麼換顏色；還有留貨到六點、出示憑條取貨的說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人日常真實的語感：um、well、so、haha、fair。聽完你就會用：Who's it for?、What were you hoping to spend?、Can you wrap it?、I'll keep it till six。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴噹。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Steak and defend!" — what English will you actually hear while picking a birthday gift at a small shop? This is a 60-line immersive listening practice set at a cozy gift-shop counter.

You will hear: describing who the gift is for and your budget; chatting from aprons to knife sets to candles; asking for a gift receipt; swapping wrap colors when gold paper runs out; and holding a wrapped gift for after-work pickup.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the fillers Americans really use: um, well, so, haha, fair. By the end you'll own phrases like Who's it for?, What were you hoping to spend?, Can you wrap it?, and I'll keep it till six.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧挑生日禮物英文｜預算換選項・禮物收據・包裝留貨｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
好友要滿三十歲了，你走進禮品店卻完全不知道該買什麼，怎麼辦？預算怎麼開口？包裝紙剛好沒貨了又該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進一間溫馨禮品店，從說清送禮對象、聊興趣、比較價位、要禮物收據，到挑包裝色、留貨取貨，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🕯️ 聊喜好：Um, she loves cooking and terrible puns.
💵 談預算：Um, around fifteen, maybe twenty at most.
🎁 要收據：Oh yes, totally needed for surprise stuff.
🛍️ 留貨取貨：I'll keep it behind the counter till six.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟挑禮物之旅走一趟，下次走進任何店，話就自己冒出來。

祝你也挑到讓朋友大喊哇的禮物。
script.thumbnail_action: holding a small wrapped candle tin
